pages.text: Don't blink. It has already priced your rubies.

pages.title: The Policy
pages.text: Weeping Angels and OreSpawn now share paperwork — three clauses, all quiet data stitched into the angels' own rulebook: detection, theft, retaliation.$(p)Read the clauses in order. For once in this pack's insurance history, you are the beneficiary.

pages.title: Clause One — Detection
pages.text: The Timey Wimey Detector now pings OreSpawn's teleporting anomalies: Ender Knights, Ender Reapers, the Vortex, and Fairies all register as angel-adjacent physics.$(p)So when the detector starts ticking with no statue in sight, one of Danger's teleporters is working the area. Or there is a statue, and you simply haven't seen it yet. Treat the tick as load-bearing information either way.

pages.title: Clause Two — Theft
pages.text: Angels pickpocket: loose rubies and titanium ingots can vanish from your pockets into theirs. The upside of institutional theft is recovery — an angel that robbed you is carrying your valuables, which converts 'terrifying statue' into 'walking strongbox'.$(p)Fencing stolen rubies is an established economy out there — see $(l:orespawn_integrations:living_world/structure_treasures)Structure Treasures$() for who else deals in them.

pages.title: Clause Three — Retaliation
pages.text: Angels shrug off nearly every weapon ever made. The shortlist of exceptions now includes Big Bertha and the Royal Guardian Sword — ten feet of ruby-edged steel does not need to blink. Felling one earns Don't Blink, Bertha.$(p)Both swords also learned how to move — see $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/weapon_movesets)Weapon Move-Sets$() before you go statue-tipping.
